manual.title: Add a printer manually
manual.description: No printer was recognised by its Bluetooth name ({count} other devices are visible). Pick the device and tell Home Assistant which model it is — these printers only report a firmware version, not their model, so the advertised name is the only way to know which speed and heat settings to use.

data_description.address: Choose from the visible Bluetooth devices, or type the address (for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF) if the printer is not listed.
data_description.model: Pick the model closest to yours. Upper- and lower-case suffixes (X6h vs X6H) are different models with different heat settings.

abort.not_supported: This device does not look like a supported cat printer.
abort.unsupported_model: This model requires a per-model secret (or a flow control scheme) that this integration does not implement.

error.invalid_address: That is not a valid Bluetooth address.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read battery and status. Each poll opens a BLE connection, and an ESP32 Bluetooth proxy has only three connection slots.
data_description.keep_connection: Holds the BLE connection open between jobs, trading a proxy connection slot for a faster first print. Leave off unless you print often.
data_description.interval_ms: Pause between BLE packets. 0 uses the profile value for your model (2–6 ms on most). Raise it if prints come out with missing bands.
data_description.packet_size_cap: Upper bound on packet size, whatever the printer's MTU says. Lower it over a Bluetooth proxy that drops large writes.

print.name: Print
print.description: Render a payload and print it.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: Payload describing what to draw (imagespec format).

height.name: Height
height.description: Canvas height in pixels. Width is fixed to the print head (384 px on 2" models).

rotate.name: Rotate
rotate.description: Rotate the drawing (0, 90, 180, 270). With 90/270 you author the payload on a height × 384 canvas (along the paper) and the output is still a 384 × height strip.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: 'image' prints with the image heat/speed profile; 'text' with the (usually hotter, crisper) text profile.

density.name: Density
density.description: Darkness 1–7. 4 is the default; each step changes heater energy by 15 %.

energy.name: Energy
energy.description: Raw heater energy (0–65535). Overrides density. Leave empty to use the profile.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Raw per-row delay. Smaller is faster. Leave empty to use the profile.

feed.name: Feed after print
feed.description: Dots of paper to advance after the last row so the print clears the tear bar. Defaults to the profile (96 on most models).

copies.name: Copies
copies.description: How many identical copies to print.

preview.name: Preview only
preview.description: Return the rendered image as a base64 data URL instead of printing it.

dots.name: Dots
dots.description: How many dot rows to advance (203 dpi: 8 dots ≈ 1 mm).
